text: Good evening, very sorry to be disturbing at this hour. I am the grandfather of Anika, she is 7 years. Her temperature is 39.1, I checked two times only. What is worrying me is that she is shivering like anything, and her hands and feet are cold like ice, even though the fever is so high. I am not sure if this is normal with fever or not. Otherwise it is mostly cold-type symptoms, her nose is running and blocked and she is sneezing since yesterday. Her colour is fine I think, face and lips look normal to me, not pale or anything. She is passing urine properly also, she went to the bathroom just now. Her parents are away tonight so I did not want to take chance. Kindly advise, and again sorry for the trouble.
